newsitem.title: USA: Evans Inc says fur sales improving.
newsitem.headline: Evans Inc says fur sales improving.

text.p: Evans Inc, a fur and womens' apparel retailer, said Tuesday fur sales have been improving in recent months.

"After a disappointing March, caused by the lack of available product at certain promotional price points, the trend in fur sales has steadily improved into early July," Evans chief financial officer William Koziel said in a news release.
Earlier Tuesday, Evans reported a net loss of $1.2 million, or $0.25 a share for its fiscal 1998 first quarter ended in May, compared to a loss of $791,000, or $0.16 a share, a year ago.
